requestBody: Faka ikheli le-imeyili olisebenzisela i-Vaultara. Sizokuthumelela isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa. Akukho okususwayo uze uqinisekise.
sentBody: Uma kukhona i-akhawunti ye-Vaultara esebenzisa leli kheli, siyithumelele isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa. Isixhumanisi siphelelwa yisikhathi ehoreni eli-1. Uma kungafiki lutho, hlola ifolda yogaxekile.
item4: Izixhumanisi zakho zokwabelana, izixhumanisi zekhalenda nobulungu bomuzi
subscriptionNote: Ukususa i-akhawunti yakho akukukhanseli ukubhalisa. Kukhansele ku-Google Play noma ku-App Store ukuze ungakhokhiswa futhi.
doneBody: I-akhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara nedatha yayo kususiwe. Ungavala leli khasi.
donePendingBody: Siqalile ukususa i-akhawunti yakho. Kungathatha amahora ambalwa ukuqeda. Ungavala leli khasi.
failed: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Hlola ukuxhumeka kwakho bese uzama futhi.
rateLimited: Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Linda isikhashana bese uzama futhi.
expiredBody: Izixhumanisi zisebenza ihora eli-1. Faka i-imeyili yakho futhi ukuze uthole esisha.
usedBody: Le akhawunti kungenzeka isisusiwe. Uma usenayo i-akhawunti, cela isixhumanisi esisha.
invalidBody: Isixhumanisi kungenzeka asiphelele. Sivule futhi ku-imeyili noma ucele esisha.
step1: Faka ngezansi ikheli le-imeyili olisebenzisela i-Vaultara.
step3: Hlola imininingwane bese uqinisekisa. Ngemva kwalokho i-akhawunti yakho iyasuswa.
inApp: Ungasusa futhi i-akhawunti yakho ku-app ye-Vaultara: Iphrofayela, bese Ukuphepha nobumfihlo, bese Susa i-akhawunti.
keptBody: Akukho okunye okugcinwa ku-Vaultara. Amakhophi angahlala kuzipele zakwa-Google Cloud amasonto ambalwa aze abhalwe ngaphezulu. Amarekhodi umthetho osidinga ukuthi siwagcine, njengamarekhodi entela, agcinwa kuphela isikhathi esidingwa umthetho. I-Google Play ne-Apple zigcina awazo amarekhodi okuthenga kwakho.
